title: Triage remote branches with unmerged commits
description:
## Goal
Remote branches with unmerged commits that are not part of the current work. Decide per branch: merge, rebase and PR, or delete.

Branches (commits ahead of main on 2026-10-17): branch (1), feat/gdrive-residio-corpus (24), feature/graph-extraction-layer (6), feature/graph-extractor-baselines (10), feature/reinforcement-memory (11), feature/shared-anthus-footer (3), fix/dependabot-vulnerabilities (1), retrieval-extraction-run-fallback (4), update-docs (1), dev (2), develop (1; CI lists it as an integration branch but it is behind main; make it real or delete it), cursor/catalog-compat-main-156a (1, likely superseded by main's catalog_compat), cursor/kanbus-264-agent-provenance-44d0 (1, PR 58 draft), docs/anthus-readme-closer (1, PR 57 draft), codex/topic-intent-modeling-sanitized (1).

Method: for each, check whether the content is already on main by patch equivalence (`git cherry origin/main origin/<branch>`). Only branches whose cherry output is all `-` are safe to delete. Report anything with `+` lines to Ryan. Close or merge drafts 57 and 58.
